method: Each current known text occurrence is independently located in the actual PDF; central original PNG paper calibration maps it to pixels. Thin contiguous horizontal rules throughout the actual full glyph bounding-box height are measured (the earlier fixed four-point baseline window excluded some upper-glyph collisions). A failure requires >=4 dark pixels of a non-descender letter both above and at least two pixels below the measured rule; ordinary lines below text and descenders alone do not fail this test. This is a lower-bound demonstrated overlap census, not a claim every other visual dimension passes.
